sections.title_en: What Welcome to Power BI for Data Analytics means
sections.title_bn: Data Analytics-এর জন্য Power BI-এ স্বাগতম কী
sections.body_en: Power BI is Microsoft’s business analytics platform for connecting to data, transforming it, building governed semantic models, creating interactive reports, and sharing insights. Power BI Desktop is the main authoring application; the Power BI service supports publishing, collaboration, refresh, and governed consumption. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Data Analytics-এর জন্য Power BI-এ স্বাগতম বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Business question → Power Query → Semantic model → DAX measures → Report → Validate → Publish

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts use Power BI when a repeatable report needs a defined model, reusable measures, interactive filtering, and a controlled delivery process rather than a one-off spreadsheet. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst Data Analytics-এর জন্য Power BI-এ স্বাগতম ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

Identify whether the task belongs in Power Query, the semantic model, DAX, the report layer, or the Power BI service.

sections.title_en: What Explore the Power BI Desktop Interface means
sections.title_bn: Power BI Desktop Interface Explore করুন কী
sections.body_en: Power BI Desktop organizes work across Report, Data, Model, DAX Query, and other authoring views. The ribbon, canvas, panes, fields, model objects, and status indicators support different stages of the analytical workflow. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Power BI Desktop Interface Explore করুন বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Report view | Data view | Model view | Power Query Editor | DAX Query view

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Recognizing where to transform data, manage relationships, create measures, and design visuals reduces accidental work in the wrong layer. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst Power BI Desktop Interface Explore করুন ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.body_en: A Power BI report contains interactive pages connected to a semantic model. A dashboard is a service-only single canvas made from pinned tiles. An app packages selected workspace content for a defined audience. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.

sections.title_en: What Data Types and Locale means
sections.body_en: Power Query data types affect parsing, relationships, aggregations, compression, and DAX behavior. Locale determines how text dates and decimal separators are interpreted. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it

chapters.title_en: Replace Errors and Handle Missing Values

chapters.summary_en: Errors, nulls, blanks, zeroes, and unknown categories are different states. Power Query can remove, replace, or retain them, but the correct action depends on business meaning.

sections.title_en: What Replace Errors and Handle Missing Values means
sections.title_bn: Error Replace ও Missing Value Handle কী
sections.body_en: Errors, nulls, blanks, zeroes, and unknown categories are different states. Power Query can remove, replace, or retain them, but the correct action depends on business meaning. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Error Replace ও Missing Value Handle বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Identify issue → Decide rule → Replace/Remove/Retain → Add quality flag → Re-profile

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts profile each issue, preserve evidence of source problems, and avoid replacing missing numeric values with zero unless zero is truly the correct business value. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst Error Replace ও Missing Value Handle ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.title_en: What Group By in Power Query means
sections.body_en: Power Query Group By summarizes rows into a new table using one or more keys and aggregations. It changes the table grain and should not be confused with interactive DAX measures. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Power Query-তে Group By বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Home → Group By → Choose key columns → Choose aggregation → Validate totals

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts use Group By for preprocessing or source-level summaries when detailed rows are not required in the model. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst Power Query-তে Group By ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.title_en: What Append Queries and Combine Files means
sections.title_bn: Query Append ও File Combine কী
sections.body_en: Append stacks rows from tables with compatible columns. The folder combine experience applies a sample transformation to many files and then appends their results. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Query Append ও File Combine বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Append Queries | Get Data → Folder → Combine & Transform Data

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts use append for monthly extracts and folder ingestion, while monitoring file schema, hidden files, duplicate loads, and source metadata. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst Query Append ও File Combine ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.title_en: What Parameters, Privacy Levels, and Query Folding means
sections.title_bn: Parameter, Privacy Level ও Query Folding কী
sections.body_en: Parameters make source paths and filters configurable. Privacy levels help prevent unintended data leakage between sources. Query folding allows supported transformations to be translated and executed by the source system. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Parameter, Privacy Level ও Query Folding বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।

sections.title_en: What Fact and Dimension Tables means
sections.body_en: Fact tables record measurable events at a declared grain. Dimension tables describe entities such as date, product, customer, geography, or employee and normally contain unique keys. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Fact ও Dimension Table বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts separate facts and dimensions to support reusable filtering and prevent repeated descriptive attributes from creating inconsistent groupings. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst Fact ও Dimension Table ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.title_en: What Filter Context means
sections.body_en: Filter context is the set of filters applied by visuals, slicers, page filters, relationships, and DAX expressions. A measure can return a different value in every visual cell because each cell has a different context. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Filter Context বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: A matrix cell for Region = Dhaka and Year = 2026 evaluates [Total Revenue] under both filters.

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts explain measure behavior by listing the filters active at the point of evaluation. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst Filter Context ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: What CALCULATE and Context Transition means
sections.body_en: CALCULATE evaluates an expression in a modified filter context. It can add, replace, or remove filters. When used in row context, it also performs context transition, converting current-row values into filters. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.

sections.title_en: What FILTER, ALL, REMOVEFILTERS, and KEEPFILTERS means
sections.title_bn: FILTER, ALL, REMOVEFILTERS ও KEEPFILTERS কী
sections.body_en: FILTER returns rows meeting an expression; ALL and REMOVEFILTERS clear filters; KEEPFILTERS intersects new filters with existing context. These functions control how a measure responds to report selections. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: FILTER, ALL, REMOVEFILTERS ও KEEPFILTERS বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Revenue Share = DIVIDE([Total Revenue], CALCULATE([Total Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS(DimProduct)))

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts use them to build shares, benchmarks, and conditional populations while avoiding accidental filter removal. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst FILTER, ALL, REMOVEFILTERS ও KEEPFILTERS ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.title_en: What DIVIDE, BLANK, and Defensive DAX means
sections.title_bn: DIVIDE, BLANK ও Defensive DAX কী
sections.body_en: DIVIDE safely handles zero or blank denominators. BLANK represents the absence of a meaningful result and often produces cleaner visuals than forced zeroes. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: DIVIDE, BLANK ও Defensive DAX বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Average Order Value = DIVIDE([Total Revenue], [Order Count])

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts define when a metric is not applicable, distinguish missing from zero, and avoid hiding data-quality problems with broad IFERROR-style logic. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst DIVIDE, BLANK ও Defensive DAX ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.title_en: What YTD, QTD, and MTD Measures means
sections.title_bn: YTD, QTD ও MTD Measure কী
sections.body_en: TOTALYTD, TOTALQTD, TOTALMTD, or CALCULATE with date functions can accumulate a base measure from the beginning of a period to the current date context. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: YTD, QTD ও MTD Measure বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Revenue YTD = TOTALYTD([Total Revenue], DimDate[Date])

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts use these measures for progress reporting but label them clearly and compare like-for-like incomplete periods. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst YTD, QTD ও MTD Measure ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: What Cards, Tables, and Matrices means
sections.body_en: Cards emphasize a small number of KPIs; tables show detailed records; matrices support grouped rows, columns, subtotals, and drill. Each requires intentional formatting and context labels. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Card, Table ও Matrix বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Card: [Total Revenue] | Matrix: Region × Month with Revenue and Margin %

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts use cards for headline metrics and tables or matrices when users need exact values or hierarchical detail. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst Card, Table ও Matrix ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.title_en: What Drill Down with Hierarchies means
sections.body_en: Drill features move through hierarchy levels such as Year, Quarter, Month, and Date. Users can drill one point, expand all levels, or move back up. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Hierarchy দিয়ে Drill Down বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Year → Quarter → Month → Date

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts create intentional hierarchies and provide titles or navigation cues so users understand the current level. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst Hierarchy দিয়ে Drill Down ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.title_en: What Publish from Desktop to the Power BI Service means

sections.body_en: Publishing sends a report and its semantic model to a selected workspace. Publication does not automatically define audience permissions, refresh, endorsement, or lifecycle controls. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it

sections.title_en: What Object-level Security and Sensitivity Concepts means
sections.title_bn: Object-level Security ও Sensitivity Concept কী
sections.body_en: Object-level security can hide model tables or columns from unauthorized users in supported scenarios. Sensitivity labels classify content and help organizational information-protection policies travel with data. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Object-level Security ও Sensitivity Concept বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Classify content → Restrict access → Test effective permissions → Monitor distribution

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts coordinate security and classification with administrators and avoid presenting labels as a substitute for access control. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst Object-level Security ও Sensitivity Concept ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.title_en: What Build Accessible Power BI Reports means
sections.title_bn: Accessible Power BI Report তৈরি করুন কী
sections.body_en: Accessible reports use sufficient contrast, meaningful titles, alt text, logical tab order, keyboard-friendly navigation, non-color cues, and clear labels. Accessibility should be designed and tested, not added at the end. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.
sections.body_bn: Accessible Power BI Report তৈরি করুন বুঝতে feature-এর নামের পাশাপাশি data কোন layer-এ transform, model, calculate বা present হচ্ছে তা বুঝতে হবে। সঠিক layer বেছে নিলে refresh, reuse, security ও interpretation বেশি reliable হয়।
sections.code: Contrast → Alt text → Tab order → Keyboard test → Non-color cues → Clear titles

sections.title_en: How a data analyst uses it
sections.body_en: Analysts test keyboard navigation and screen-reader descriptions and avoid communicating status by color alone. A professional workflow records the business rule, source grain, model assumptions, and validation evidence before the output is shared.
sections.body_bn: Data analyst Accessible Power BI Report তৈরি করুন ব্যবহার করার আগে business question, source grain, expected output এবং validation rule লিখে রাখেন। কাজের পরে result reconcile করেন এবং unsupported conclusion এড়িয়ে limitation document করেন।

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।

sections.title_en: What Portfolio Project Part 1: Requirements and Model Plan means

sections.body_en: The final project begins with stakeholder questions, metric definitions, source inventory, quality risks, fact grain, dimension design, and a page-level report plan. Building visuals before these decisions creates rework and inconsistent metrics. The purpose is not to memorize menu paths; it is to understand which layer owns the logic and how that choice affects refresh, reuse, security, and interpretation.

sections.title_en: Rules, checks, and common mistakes
sections.body_en: Common mistakes include placing logic in the wrong layer, relying on automatic detection without verification, mixing grains, using unclear names, and trusting a visually plausible result without reconciliation. Change one thing at a time, validate it, and preserve evidence.
sections.body_bn: Common mistake হলো wrong layer-এ logic রাখা, automatic detection verify না করা, ভিন্ন grain mix করা, unclear name ব্যবহার করা এবং visually plausible result-কে reconciliation ছাড়া trust করা। একবারে একটি change করুন, validate করুন এবং evidence সংরক্ষণ করুন।
